alt: A Samsung smart refrigerator with a large touchscreen display panel built into the front door, showing the connected-appliance interface that turned a fridge into a software dependency
story: A botched SmartThings firmware update on September 22, 2026 bricked Samsung Bespoke AI 4-Door refrigerators across South Korea just days before Chuseok — cooling failed entirely, screens went dark, and owners who paid ~$4,000 for fridges with recipe AI and music playback had to discard holiday food while awaiting in-person technician visits scheduled for after the holiday.
why_funny: Samsung spent years adding AI, recipe suggestions, and music streaming to a century-old reliable appliance, then a software update stripped out the one thing a fridge absolutely must do: stay cold.
